description: This file defines the interface 'ClientCollateralManagementWritePlatformService' which declares methods for managing client collateral products, including adding, updating, and deleting collateral products.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagementWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for client collateral management write operations, defining methods for managing collateral products.

methods.name: addClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Creates a new client collateral product based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing client collateral product based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: deleteClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Deletes a client collateral product identified by the given collateral ID.
